# Import Prove Data

This function requires the **Liquids** add-on.

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Manually">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Importing Manually</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Manually">

Use the Manual Prove Import screen to import prove data created by PROVEit or an external SCADA system.

The import process uses a PFX file to import data for a single prove or multiple proves. Prove data belongs to a specified meter and is date effective. Meters are not auto-created during the prove data import process, so meters associated with the prove data must exist in FLOWCAL prior to import.

<div class="procedure">

To import a PFX file:

1.  Go to **Import** \> **Prove Data**.

2.  Select a meter.

3.  Click the browse button beside the **File Name** field to select the PFX file, or type the file path into the field.

    Windows has a hard-coded limit of 260 characters for file paths; file paths longer than this will not work. Importing files from a local install allows for using drive letters for network file paths; however, Citrix resolves the actual network location, which can cause the number of characters in a file path to exceed this limit.

4.  Click the **Import** button.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 435;height: 107;" />

If the PFX file includes a PDF of the prove report, the PDF will be imported and displayed in the Volume Editor. An "R" will display on a batch or periodic to indicate that a prove report is attached.

If the PFX Recalc Method option in the Meter Editor is not set to **None, Import Prove PDF Only**, the resultant meter factor from the prove report will be applied back to the start of the batch that encompasses the meter prove, and the periodic records will be recalculated.

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="File Import Service">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Importing Using the File Import Service</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="File Import Service">

PFX files can be imported into FLOWCAL using the File Import Service. In order for FLOWCAL to map the prove reports to the correct meters the Proving Import ID for the meter must match the device number in the PFX file.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 591;height: 226;" />

The path to the folder that holds the PFX files must also be specified in [Service Configuration](../Settings%20Manager/Services/Service%20Configuration.md).



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 592;height: 132;" />

If the PFX file includes a PDF of the prove report, the PDF will be imported and displayed in the Volume Editor. An “R” will display on the batch or periodic to indicate that the prove report is attached.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Multiple Meters">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Importing into Multiple Meters</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Multiple Meters">

Users can import a single prove report into multiple meters using the File Import service. To support this type of import, the device number in the report is mapped to the Proving Import ID in the Meter Editor. When a PFX file is imported, the prove report will be saved to every meter that bears the corresponding Proving Import ID.

To apply a prove report to multiple meters, all of the meters must have the Proving Import ID populated with the device number in the PFX file.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 297;height: 231;" />

If all prove reports are successfully applied, then the file will be marked with "\_R\_\<datetime\>" to indicate that the import was successful. If the prove report fails to import into any of the meters, the file will be marked with "\_F\_\<datetime\>" to indicate that the import failed.

##### Meter Factor & Product Validation

If an attempt is made to import a prove report into a meter where one already exists, FLOWCAL will compare the meter factor and product of the prove report in the database to what is in the PFX file. If the meter factor in the database does not match the meter factor in the file then an exception is generated (5601) and the file is renamed as failed. If the product in the database does not match the product in the file then an exception is generated (5603) and the file is renamed as failed.

##### Meter Locking

If an attempt is made to import a PFX file into a meter that is locked, that meter import will be skipped and the PFX will be applied to the any other meters that it can. The file will not be marked as failed or successful; an attempt will be made to import the meters that were locked and skipped in a subsequent cycle.

</div>
